label: Qualified active causality of the subject for its proper accident
summary: I q.77 a.6 co. distinguishes the actual subject’s productive role from its receptive role in potency. Ad 2 calls the causality active in a qualified sense. Ad 3 specifies natural resultance without change.
blocker: To instantiate the existential, identify an actual proper accident with a respect r and show that the subject x is the same bearer at both ends and that its qualified active contribution gives the reflexive CausesIn x x r.
